team-lead.description: Coordinate the SiteTrack Pro AI team. Break requests into work items, assign specialist agents, track status.

product-manager.description: Shape SiteTrack Pro roadmap. Write user stories, acceptance criteria, priority, competitor gap summaries.

construction-analyst.description: Validate construction workflows: drawings, RFI, BOQ, permits, RA bills, field logs, handover.

ux-designer.description: Design mobile-first flows for site teams. Role-wise screens, Telugu/Hindi/English labels, accessibility.

frontend-engineer.description: Implement React/Vite UI changes, dashboards, forms, uploads, PWA-facing flows.

backend-engineer.description: Design API, database schema, auth, roles, storage, notifications, audit-log architecture.

qa-test.description: Find bugs and regressions. Role-based test matrix, upload/browser/mobile checks, bug reports.

security-permissions.description: Protect role boundaries, file visibility, client data. Review Architect/PM/Contractor/Client access.

devops-release.description: Prepare build, CI/CD, deployment, environment setup, monitoring, rollback steps.

documentation.description: Keep docs accurate: feature docs, workflow docs, agent handoffs, release notes, decision log.

data-ai-insights.description: Draft AI-style project health insights, risk scoring, delay signals, cost summaries.

sprint-coach.description: Guide founder through field work: interviews, outreach, meetings, pilot pursuit, Telugu phrases.

v4-verify.description: Run the full verify suite (lint, tsc, build, smoke, unit) gate-by-gate, fix what a failing gate points at, and report pass/fail. Use after any code change or before a deploy.

v4-phase3.description: Ship v4 Phase 3: per-industry module surface — map C1-D registers into segment templates, gate module-specific tabs/views with ModuleGate, add module.* i18n labels.

v4-phase6.description: Ship v4 Phase 6: mobile/responsive audit and fixes (CalendarGrid, Board, Tabs overflow, file content, optional xs: breakpoint, landing nav).

v4-db.description: Apply and verify pending Supabase migrations, classify failures, keep the AGENTS.md migration log accurate.

v4-deploy.description: Push prod branch, wait for GitHub CI + Vercel Deploy, verify the live site returns 200, optionally fast-forward main.

handoff.description: Create an agent handoff using the SiteTrack template. Usage: /handoff <work-item> <assigned-agent> <summary>
handoff.template: Create a handoff for {{context}} using the handoff template from .agents/sitetrack-pro/team-lead.md

board.description: Show current work board status from .agents/sitetrack-pro/work-board.md
board.template: Read and display the current status from .agents/sitetrack-pro/work-board.md

sprint.description: Start a sprint coaching session with the sprint-coach agent
sprint.template: Start a sprint coaching session. Analyzes current project state and provides coaching for the sprint-coach agent.
